name: Direct & Indirect Prompt Injection
description: Untrusted user text or retrieved documents hijack agent instructions.
key_questions: Where does untrusted content enter the model context?|Are system instructions structurally separated from untrusted data?|What prevents retrieved web/doc text from triggering privileged tools?

name: Tool Over-Privilege & Data Exfiltration
description: An agent calls destructive tools or leaks sensitive data through tool outputs.
key_questions: Does every tool enforce least-privilege scope and tenant authorization on the server?|Which side-effecting tools require human approval?|Can an agent read secrets or cross-tenant records and pass them into outbound tools?

name: PII & Secret Leakage in Traces
description: Sensitive inputs leak into third-party model APIs, prompt caches, or eval logs.
key_questions: What data-retention and zero-training terms govern each model provider?|Are PII and secrets scrubbed before prompts or traces are stored?|Do tenant isolation boundaries apply to vector stores and prompt caches?

name: Ungrounded Claims & Schema Drift
description: Model fabricates facts, citations, or invalid structured output.
key_questions: Which claims require strict source grounding or deterministic validation?|How are structured outputs schema-checked and repaired or retried on failure?|What does the user see when confidence is low or grounding is missing?

name: Non-Determinism & Duplicate Side Effects
description: Model retries or variance repeat external writes or break downstream expectations.
key_questions: How are side-effecting tool calls made idempotent?|Which steps use deterministic code instead of model judgment?|Can a failed multi-step agent run resume without duplicating prior actions?

name: Provider Outage & Model Deprecation
description: Upstream model endpoint throttles, errors, or retires a snapshot.
key_questions: What fallback provider or degraded non-AI mode activates when the primary endpoint fails?|Are prompts and evals decoupled from hardcoded provider quirks so swapping models is safe?|How are rate limits and queue backpressure handled?

name: Context Bloat & Lost-in-the-Middle
description: Oversized context drops critical constraints or degrades reasoning.
key_questions: What enforces the token budget per turn or workflow stage?|How are stale tool outputs or long histories compacted without dropping invariants?|Are critical rules placed where attention holds cleanly?

name: Retrieval Staleness & Tenant Bleed
description: Indexed chunks return outdated docs or leak across customer boundaries.
key_questions: Is tenant/ACL filtering enforced before or inside vector retrieval, never in the prompt?|How quickly do edits, deletes, and permission revocations update the index?|How is retrieval recall verified separately from generation?

name: Runaway Agent Loops & Cost Spikes
description: Retry loops, recursive subagents, or uncached long contexts blow up spend.
key_questions: What hard caps bound max turns, tool calls, subagent depth, and per-run spend?|Are prompt caching and cheaper routing tiers used for classification or extraction?|What circuit breaker halts a looping run automatically?

name: Eval-to-Production Drift
description: Offline benchmark scores pass while real user traffic fails silently.
key_questions: How does the eval suite represent real adversarial and edge traffic?|Are production traces sampled into regression cases?|What rollback gate triggers if online quality or cost regresses past the Passable band?
